Release notes

What each TestFlight build changes, newest first. Testers read the notes in the app's Settings menu; this page is the site's copy.

1.0.0 · Build 2

2026-11-11 · TestFlight

  • The dew total and per-second rate at the top of the garden now show decimals under 1000 (two places below 1, one place from 1 up, rounded down), so small gains are visible right away.
  • A splash screen with the Moss Garden logo and name now opens the app, joining the iOS launch screen without a white flash.
  • Settings now has a Release notes menu that shows these notes for each build.
  • Fixed: 1000 now shows as "1K" instead of "1000".
  • Fixed: very large numbers could show a broken format.

1.0.0 · Build 1

2026-11-11 · TestFlight

  • First TestFlight build of Moss Garden: tap to water your moss garden, and it keeps growing on its own, even offline.
  • Eight plants to unlock in the plant encyclopedia, seasons that restart the garden while lasting bonuses remain, and a local save with backup and restore.
